summary.headline: Comets and Political Calamities
summary.text: Accounts of comets appearing over Tabaristan and eastern lands, followed by wars, famine, disease, earthquakes, and political upheaval. Citing ʿAli Shah Bukhari’s Ashjār al-Thimār and ʿAbd al-Razzāq Samarqandi’s Maṭlaʿ al-Saʿdayn, the passage interprets a comet in Aries as foretelling the capture of Yıldırım Bayezid, Caesar of Rome.
